# Data packs for the apps that need outside data (docs/DATAPACKS.md). One row per
# source. A pack is a release asset, never committed: datapack.py fetches a source
# only with --approved and builds packs only under build/.
# pack: core (every source TRUE: commercial use with attribution) or optional (every
# source BOTH: share-alike, shipped apart from the Apache-2.0 code). A FALSE source
# (non-commercial, no derivatives) is never listed; an unknown licence is NEITHER and
# refused. kind: file (one download), sparql (a Wikidata query, one per split), lmf
# (a wordnet archive whose lexicons are classed one by one, by their own licence),
# live (an endpoint the app reads over TLS itself; the pack carries its terms only).
